tiers.description: Above 400% FPG the discount varies by facility; uninsured patients are charged no more than AGB via the Uninsured Discount

evidence.quote: The application period begins on the date medical care is provided (or earlier if the patient choses to apply) and ends on the later of 240 days after the first post-discharge billing statement or thirty days after the hospital (or an authorized third party) provides a written notice (final bill) to the patient outlining pending Extraordinary Collection Actions.

presumptive_eligibility: Baptist may use external scoring systems to predict presumptive charity, and uninsured patients automatically receive the Uninsured Discount without an application.
how_to_apply: Complete the Financial Assistance Application (download at www.baptistonline.org/patients-and-visitors/financial-assistance, email FAP@BMHCC.org, or get one from the facility Business Office); Central Business Office (877) 348-1281.
warnings: The table says '< 200%' for 100% and starts the next band at 201%, so the exact 200% boundary is not stated.
Insured patients are excluded except Medically Underinsured patients, who get a 25% discount off patient liability above $5,000.
Only uninsured patients can apply for the financial need discount.
Discounts above 400% FPG vary by facility.
The state is not stated explicitly. Partner clinics are in Shelby County and Mississippi counties.
No asset test or residency requirement is stated; income documentation is required.
The Uninsured Discount is an AGB-based flat-rate discount that varies by facility.
